title: 第3章 天道不容？且走着瞧
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
天上掉馅饼，仙人慧眼识珠，以为天赋绝伦顿要崛起，转眼又是乌云盖顶。

    对了，她还得了一个仙人爹！

    还真是滑稽！

    有那么一瞬间，顾念念想起一个遥远的过去。

    没有皇城根，没有仙人，只有一个破旧的福利院，以及一群日日做着白日梦的孩子。

    她就是其中一员。

    努力装好，装乖，装懂事，装柔弱，装可爱……

    期盼能离开福利院，被好心人收养。

    终于，她成功了。

    那是一对很胖的夫妻，脸上永远挂着笑。

    爱笑的人总是善良的，她以为自己以后的日子会很幸福。

    所以她努力在他们面前扮演着乖巧听话懂事的样子，让他们喜欢。

    可幸福结束得很快。

    两年后，那对夫妻的儿子出生。

    一个亲生的带着他们血缘的儿子，天然就站在了绝对的优势上。

    所以，无论她再怎么扮演，也理所当然地成了那个被抛弃的人。

    那个场景和如今是如此的像！

    顾念念袖子里的手慢慢地捏紧。

    已经不知道经历过多少次被抛弃和放弃了，她已经不想再装了。

    四周的灵力在动荡，像是被什么东西惊动了。

    空间开始绷紧，发出了嘎吱嘎吱的声音。

    测试台上无人注意到这些，他们在嘲讽谩骂，说她这样的废物不配入青云宗。

    其中那个叫孟静稚的声音尤其突出。

    黑色的长发挡去了顾念念的眼底骤起的冰冷杀意，她的嘴角牵起一抹冰冷的弧度。

    心里却生出一股诡异的畅快。

    都忘了多少年了，这种释放自我的感觉。

    她缓缓抬起手，有什么在朝着她的掌心凝聚，兴奋开始爬上她的眼角。

    下一秒，一双冰凉的大手猛然扼住了她纤细弱小的手腕。

    “她是我的小师妹，亦是师尊的女儿！”

    洛靳的声音不大，却像一把冰冷的剑，直接劈开了所有的喧嚣。

    全场再次安静下来。

    所有人齐刷刷地转头看向声音的来源。

    顾念念也跟着抬头。

    怔愣的眼底反而困惑，她没有被放弃？！
content_en:
Pies fall from the sky, and the immortals are discerning, thinking that their extraordinary talents are about to rise, but in the blink of an eye, dark clouds cover them again.

    By the way, she also got a fairy father!

    How funny!

    For a moment, Gu Niannian thought of a distant past.

    There are no imperial roots, no immortals, just a dilapidated orphanage and a group of children who daydream every day.

    She is one of them.

    Try to pretend to be good, pretend to be good, pretend to be sensible, pretend to be weak, pretend to be cute...

    She hopes to leave the orphanage and be adopted by kind-hearted people.

    Finally, she succeeded.

    It was a very fat couple who always had smiles on their faces.

    People who love to laugh are always kind, and she thought she would be happy in the future.

    So she tried her best to act obedient and sensible in front of them so that they would like her.

    But happiness ends quickly.

    Two years later, the couple's son was born.

    A biological son who carries their blood naturally stands at an absolute advantage.

    Therefore, no matter how she acted, she would naturally become the abandoned one.

    That scene was so similar to today!

    Gu Niannian slowly squeezed her hands in her sleeves.

    She didn't know how many times she had been abandoned and given up, and she no longer wanted to pretend.

    The spiritual energy around him was turbulent, as if he had been disturbed by something.

    The space began to tighten and creaking sounds were made.

    No one on the test bench noticed this. They were mocking and cursing, saying that a loser like her was not worthy of joining the Qingyun Sect.

    Among them, the voice named Meng Jingzhi stood out particularly.

    The long black hair blocked the sudden cold murderous intent in Gu Niannian's eyes, and the corners of her mouth curved in an icy arc.

    There was a strange feeling of joy in my heart.

    I have forgotten how many years have passed since I felt this way of releasing myself.

    She slowly raised her hand, something was gathering in her palm, and excitement began to creep into the corners of her eyes.

    The next second, a pair of cold hands suddenly grabbed her slender wrist.

    "She is my junior sister and my master's daughter!"

    Luo Jin's voice was not loud, but like a cold sword, it cut through all the noise.

    The whole place fell silent again.

    Everyone turned to look at the source of the sound.

    Gu Niannian also looked up.

    Her stunned eyes were filled with confusion. She hadn't been given up? !
title_en: Chapter 3 God forbids it? Let's wait and see
